title: The Civilization of Knowledge: Who Has the Authority to Interpret the World

equations.label: Canonical Formula
equations.meaning: The article's single formalized 'governing formula': an agency A's mediated account M of an event/signal E is the composition of translation T_A and stabilization Π_A applied to A's selected/bounded signal S_A(E), where the selected signal is itself a bounded subset of the full space of possible signals Δ(E) about that event. Formalizes the analytical grammar signal → translation → stabilization → agency → conflict/reframing.
equations.paper_tier: definition (author-labelled 'Canonical Formula'; the paper explicitly states it does not claim all historical formations can be captured by one formula without remainder — it is an organizing heuristic, not a proven law)
